title: Comment on status illusion-proposals "Cheaper look-alike effects (user priority 2)": This fix will not used ? why ? is it not make better performance ?

messages.text: This fix will not used ? why ? is it not make better performance ?

Not used, because it did not make the page faster on the phone. It was a search for cheaper look-alike effects.

- The accent word 'you' was the one candidate. 5 image or video ways to draw it did not beat today's drawing on the iPhone.
- Drawn alone, the word had 0 slow frames. The slow frames come from the rest of the page, so changing the word would gain nothing.
- Other look-alike swaps from this search were taken as their own fixes: the countdown, the avatar slider, the end-of-page morph and the Platform glint.
- The 'finished (nothing to land)' label is the board's wording for a closed topic. The lead's label fix (T-124) will say 'closed, no change kept'.

What you need to do: nothing.

Can we put the reason into the status and any that related ? 
it'll make me catch up easier ? let's investigate.

Yes, we can, and I am sending it to the toolsmith now (ts-board, who already builds the label fix).

- The reason already exists on the Progress page: each item has 'in a build: yes/no' and a 'why not' sentence. The Status rows do not show it.
- 43 Status rows say done. Only 4 link to a Progress item (this one, style-recalc, rest-script, best-stack). The other 39 are tool and review jobs with no build to land.
- The plan: a done row shows 'in best build' or 'not used, because ...' from Progress, and a closed job without a build says 'finished, no build'.
- Not decided yet: the wording. I will post it here when ts-board answers.

What you need to do: nothing.

Update from the toolsmith (ts-board): the new row labels are being built and tested now.

- Parked rows show one clear label: 'done, waits for build v8', 'unfinished, paused until ...' or 'standing by'. A row with no reason shows a red 'needs review'.
- A Status row that disagrees with the Progress page shows a red 'does not match' line. 7 such rows exist today and are being fixed.
- Your ask (the reason on done rows) goes in the same change.
- Time: about 30-40 min to land if the test queue is short. The comment-badge fix (T-137) comes right after.

What you need to do: nothing.
